chapters: In the second year of King Daryavesh, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of Havayah came to Chaggai, the prophet to Zerubavel son of Shealtiel, governor of Yehudah, and to Yehoshua son of Yehozadak the High Priest, saying:
So Havayah of Hosts said, saying: This people has said, "The time has not come — the time for the house of Havayah to be built."
And the word of Havayah came through Chaggai the prophet, saying:
Is it an appropriate time for you yourselves to sit in your ceiled houses, when this house is in ruins?
And now, so Havayah of Hosts said: Consider your ways.
You have sown much and you bring in little. You eat without being satiated. You drink without getting your fill. You dress, and it has no warmth. And he who profits, profits into a bundle with holes.
So Havayah of Hosts said: Consider your ways.
Ascend the mountain, bring wood, and build the house — and I will accept it, and I will be honored, Havayah said.

You looked for much, and behold, it became little. And you brought it home, and I will blow into it. Because of what? Havayah of Hosts says, Because of My house that is lying in ruins. Yet you run, each to his house.
Therefore because of you the heavens have kept back, so that there is no dew, and the earth has kept back its produce.

And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the grain, and upon the wine, and upon the oil, and upon everything that the ground will bring forth — and upon man, and upon beast, and upon all the labor of their hands.

And Zerubavel the son of Shealtiel, and Yehoshua the son of Yehozadak the High Priest, and all the remnant of the people heeded the command of Havayah their Elokim and the words of Chaggai the prophet, as Havayah their Elokim had sent him, and the people feared Havayah.
And Chaggai, the messenger of Havayah, said in fulfilling Havayah's mission to the people, saying: I am with you, Havayah says.

And Havayah inspired the spirit of Zerubavel the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Yehudah, and the spirit of Yehoshua the son of Yehozadak the High Priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people, and they came and performed labor in the house of Havayah of Hosts, their Elokim
on the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of King Daryavesh.
In the seventh month, on the twenty — first of the month, the word of Havayah came through Chaggai the prophet, saying:
Say now to Zerubavel the son of Shealtiel, the governor of Yehudah, and to Yehoshua the son of Yehozadak the High Priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying:
Who among you is left, who saw this house in its former glory? And as you see it now, is it not as nothing in your eyes?

And now, be strong, Zerubavel, Havayah says; and be strong, Yehoshua the son of Yehozadak the High Priest; and be strong, all the people of the land, Havayah says. And (for I am with you, Havayah of Hosts says) do
the thing that I set up with you when you left Mitzrayim. And My spirit stands in your midst; fear not.
For so Havayah of Hosts said: There will rise another one, and I will shake up the heaven and the earth and the sea and the dry land for a little while.
And I will shake up all the nations, and they shall come with the precious things of all the nations. And I will fill this House with glory, Havayah of Hosts said.
The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, Havayah of Hosts says.
The glory of this last House shall be greater than the first one, Havayah of Hosts said. And in this place I will grant peace, Havayah of Hosts says.
On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Daryavesh, the word of Havayah came to Chaggai the prophet, saying:
So Havayah of Hosts said: Now ask the priests the Torah, saying:

"Should a man carry contaminated flesh in the skirt of his garment, if it touches in his skirt the bread and the pottage and the wine and the oil, or any food, will it the food become contaminated?" And the priests replied and said, "No."
And Chaggai said, "If the contamination of a dead body touches all these, will it become contaminated?" And the priests replied and said, "It will become contaminated."
And Chaggai replied and said, "So is this people, and so is this nation before Me, Havayah says; and so is all the work of their hands, and whatever they sacrifice there is contaminated.
And now, consider from this day and before — before placing a stone upon a stone in the Temple of Havayah
so that they should not come to a heap of twenty measures, and there would be ten; similarly, when one would come to the winevat to draw off fifty press-measures, and there would be twenty.
I smote you with blast and with yellowing and with hail in all the work of your hands, and you are not returning to Me, Havayah says.
Pay attention now, from this day and before — from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month — from the day that the Temple of Havayah was founded, pay attention.
The seed is still in the granary, and the grapevines, the fig trees, the pomegranate trees, and the olive trees have not yet borne fruit — from this day I will bless."
And the word of Havayah came to Chaggai a second time on the twenty-fourth of the month, saying:
Say to Zerubavel, the governor of Yehudah, saying: I am shaking up the heaven and the earth.

And I will overthrow the throne of the kingdoms, and I will destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations. And I will overthrow the chariots and their riders; and the horses and their riders shall come down, each one by the sword of his brother.
On that day, Havayah of Hosts says, I will take you, O Zerubavel the son of Shealtiel, My servant; Havayah says, and I will make you as a signet; for I have chosen you, Havayah of Hosts says.
